notes:
Per-channel subscribe UI on the Bridge tab — small focused release.

### Discord per-channel filter

v1.0.21 + v1.0.22 listened to ALL channels in your Discord server. v1.0.23 adds a checkbox-per-channel picker under the Bot card on the Bridge tab. Tick the channels you want signals from, leave the rest unticked. Empty selection still defaults to 'listen to everything' so existing users see no behaviour change unless they actively choose channels.

Channels are fetched directly from Discord with the bot token, sorted in the same order they appear in your Discord client. Toggles save automatically (300ms debounce — no Save button to remember).

### Telegram source picker

Telegram's listener architecture is one source group at a time, so the picker is a radio-list of every group / channel your userbot is in. Pick the one you want signals from; the listener re-binds without a restart. Direct messages are filtered out.

Each row shows a CH or GR badge so you can tell channels from groups at a glance.

### What's not in this release

Multi-source listening (multiple Telegram groups in parallel) needs a listener-architecture refactor and is queued for v1.0.24+ alongside the BrokerExecutor / cTrader / TradingView relay work.
